economic_hypothesis: Broad market labels can hide simultaneous industry bull and bear structures. A stock should be matched to the supply-demand mechanism of its own causally known PIT industry: distributed accumulation can continue only inside a locally strong industry, while a weak industry requires observable selling exhaustion and demand takeover. Mixed local states remain cash.
novelty_boundary: This tests local PIT-industry state routing, not another global BULL/BEAR threshold, industry-follower rank acceleration, industry momentum, industry diffusion variant, or parameter change to either mother event.

local_industry_state.population: same-date hard-valid, current-valid, non-ST securities with valid PIT causal_industry and completed ret20/ret60
local_industry_state.latest_information: completed signal-date closes whose available_at is no later than each row's decision_at
local_industry_state.LOCAL_BULL: industry median ret20 > 0 AND median ret60 > 0 AND positive-ret20 share > 0.50 AND positive-ret60 share > 0.50
local_industry_state.LOCAL_BEAR: industry median ret20 <= 0 AND median ret60 <= 0 AND positive-ret20 share <= 0.50 AND positive-ret60 share <= 0.50
local_industry_state.LOCAL_TRANSITION: every other valid industry configuration; hold cash

frozen_mothers.stock_setup: exact prior mother without its global-state clause: prior20 return 5% to 25%; at least 60% positive sessions; maximum absolute daily return below 7%; downside/upside turnover ratio at most 0.65
frozen_mothers.trigger: completed 2% to 7% non-limit session, close location at least 0.75, close above the prior20 high, turnover 1.20x to 2.50x the prior20 median
frozen_mothers.cooldown: more than 20 market sessions since the prior raw same-mechanism event
frozen_mothers.translation: +15% gross target or H30, first legal open within three later market sessions, 40 bps round trip

frozen_mothers.stock_setup: exact prior mother without its global-state clause: prior20 return at most -8%; latest five-session low no lower than the preceding five-session low; latest five-session downside turnover no greater than the preceding five-session downside turnover
frozen_mothers.trigger: completed 2% to 7% non-limit session, close location at least 0.75, close above the prior5 high, turnover 1.00x to 2.50x the prior20 median
frozen_mothers.cooldown: more than 20 market sessions since the prior raw same-mechanism event
frozen_mothers.translation: +10% gross target or H20, first legal open within three later market sessions, 40 bps round trip

data_and_execution.PIT_industry_membership: causal_industry on the completed signal date

research_sequence: build identity-only candidates and verify every 2014-2020 year has more than 50 combined signals
render every candidate with 126 completed sessions before and after
compress repeated chart observations into at most five causal rules
freeze one rule set before aggregation
require more than 50 completed signals and mean net return above 4 percent in every 2014-2020 calendar year before any later-period opening
prohibited: 2022-2024 signal or outcome read before the strict development gate
